body: To the editor: I have lived on Quincy Place for 39 years, and I want to say what a difference the Cedar Hollow Garden Club has made. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the October meeting.
Please keep the Saturday cleanup day in the budget. Many of us on Quincy Place use it every week.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Sergio Zielinski, Lower Millrace
